## Purpose

Nordlofsystems.se is both the company website for Nordlöf Systems and the professional CV and project portfolio of Erica Nordlöf. The site presents freelance services, real business experience, technical portfolio projects, education and availability for smaller assignments, subcontracting, part-time work, future internship/LIA and developer roles.

## Erica Nordlöf

Erica is a Malmö-based business owner and software developer with first-hand experience from running Offroad Bumpis, a rental business. She has a Full-Stack Developer certificate from Distansakademin and studies Fullstack Java (YH) at Chas Academy in Malmö during 2026-2028.

Her background also includes property maintenance, gardening, warehouse and transport work. This practical experience informs a preference for clear requirements, written decisions, testable workflows and systems that support real operations.

## Current opportunities

- Clearly scoped freelance assignments
- Assignments through Partna
- Subcontracting for agencies and development teams
- Part-time or extra work in software and web development
- Future LIA/internship cooperation
- Junior software developer roles in Malmö or remote

## Specialisation

The main commercial specialisation is digital systems for rental businesses throughout Sweden: websites, booking, inventory availability, quotations, customer portals, rental documentation, integrations and automation.

## Selected work and status

- Offroad Bumpis — own rental business and live production workflows.
- Safe Standard — own rental documentation product and deployed demo.
- Bumperball Leadgenerator — internal portfolio tool for scoring, deduplication and controlled contact preparation.
- RentChain — privacy-first rental portfolio demo with off-chain personal data and SHA-256 integrity proofs.
- FlowForge Java Platform — Java/Spring Boot portfolio project with REST, PostgreSQL, validation, tests, Docker and CI.
- Fastighetsnavet — full-stack property-management portfolio project with React, TypeScript, Node, Express, SQLite and JWT.
- ResilientCore Lab — infrastructure portfolio lab focused on resilient networks, automation, security and incident engineering.
